products.list.caption: Products
products.list.searchHint: The start of a slug, or an exact SKU of any variant (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; at most {max}). Titles are not searched.
products.list.searchPattern: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen only
products.list.searchInvalid: Use only letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen: a slug or a SKU contains nothing else.
products.list.categoryHint: Products assigned to this category itself, not to its subcategories.
products.create.next: Fill in its attributes and categories in the editor; variants, prices and stock follow.
products.form.title: Title
products.form.slugHintCreate: The product’s address in the shop. Leave it empty to make one from the title.
products.form.slugHintEdit: The product’s address in the shop: lowercase letters and digits separated by single hyphens. Changing it changes the address.
products.form.productTypeHint: Decides which attributes and options the product has. It cannot be changed later.
products.notice.unpublished: The product is back to draft and no longer in the shop.
products.notice.archived: The product is archived and no longer in the shop.
products.notice.restored: The product is restored as a draft.
products.lifecycle.label: Product status actions
products.lifecycle.locked: Save or undo the changes on this tab first.
products.lifecycle.unpublishBody: It disappears from the shop at once and becomes a draft. You can publish it again.
products.lifecycle.archiveBody: It disappears from the shop and from new orders. You can restore it as a draft later.
products.lifecycle.deleteBody: The product, its variants, options, categories and media are deleted for good. Only a product that was never published can be deleted.
products.lifecycle.deleteHint: A product that was ever published cannot be deleted: archive it instead.
products.problems.title: The product cannot be published yet. Fix these and publish again:
products.problems.onTab: Problems from the last publish attempt
products.attributes.none: This product type has no product attributes.
products.attributes.unknownChoices: Stored choices that are not options any more: {codes}.
products.attributes.noChoices: This attribute has no options yet.
products.attributes.hint.decimals: At most {max} decimal places, with a dot.
products.attributeIssue.notANumber: Enter a number with digits and an optional dot, for example 12.5.
products.categories.none: The product is in no category yet.
products.categories.limit: A product can be in at most {max} categories.
products.attributeReason.values_not_an_o: The attribute values are not in the expected form.
products.attributeReason.values_too_larg: The attribute values are too large together (at most 64 KB).
products.attributeReason.unknown_attribu: This product type has no such product attribute.
products.attributeReason.null_value: An attribute cannot be empty in this way; clear the field instead.
products.attributeReason.invalid_definit: The attribute’s own rules are not valid; fix them in the attribute.
products.attributeReason.invalid_type: This value has the wrong type for the attribute.
products.attributeReason.empty: Enter a value or clear the field.
products.attributeReason.too_short: The text is shorter than the attribute allows.
products.attributeReason.too_long: The text is longer than the attribute allows.
products.attributeReason.invalid_charact: The text contains characters that cannot be stored.
products.attributeReason.locale_not_allo: This language is not one of the shop’s content languages.
products.attributeReason.default_locale_: The text in the default language is missing.
products.attributeReason.too_many_decima: The number has more decimal places than the attribute allows.
products.attributeReason.below_min: The value is below the attribute’s minimum.
products.attributeReason.above_max: The value is above the attribute’s maximum.
products.attributeReason.unknown_option: This choice is not one of the attribute’s options.
products.media.intro: Images of the product, at most {max}, in the order shown here: the first one is the product's main image. Add each image by its address (http or https) or upload files.
products.media.policy: The admin shows a preview only for image hosts its content policy allows; an image from another host is reported in text instead. The shop shows it if its own policy allows the host.
products.media.none: The product has no images yet.
products.media.previewFailed: The preview could not be shown. The image host may not be allowed by the admin's content policy, or the address is wrong.
products.media.urlHint: Starts with http:// or https://, at most 2048 characters.
products.media.altHint: Describes the image for people who cannot see it; at most {max} characters per language. Optional; once given, the default language is needed too.
products.media.linkHint: The shop shows this image when a buyer chooses the value.
products.media.unknownLink: A value the product no longer uses
products.media.full: A product can have at most {max} images.
products.media.removeBody: Stored images that this save removes: {count}. Their addresses and texts are deleted; the files elsewhere stay.
products.media.urlInvalid: Enter a full address that starts with http:// or https://, without a user name or password, at most 2048 characters.
products.media.linkNotChosen: The product has not chosen this value; choose another or none.
products.options.noneUsed: The product uses no options: it is sold as one variant.
products.options.allChosen: Every value of this option is chosen already.
products.options.planAddOnly: Only new values are added: the existing variants stay and the new combinations get variants ({after} variants in all).
products.options.planRebuild: This change adds or removes an option or removes a value. All {now} variants are deleted and {after} are generated from the new options: their SKUs, barcodes, attribute values, flags and prices are lost. It is refused if a variant has stock history or was ordered.
products.options.replaceIntro: Choose the options of the product type the product uses and their values: at most {maxOptions} options and {maxValues} values each. Every combination of values becomes a variant.
products.options.noneAllowed: The product type allows no options. Add options to the product type first.
products.options.notAllowed: The product type no longer allows this option; remove it before publishing.
products.options.namesFailed: The names of the options could not be loaded; codes are shown.
products.options.frozenBody: This product was published, so its options and chosen values cannot be changed or removed. You can add a value to an option it uses: variants are generated for the new combinations. To change the options, create a new product.
products.options.addValueBody: Variants are generated for the new combinations. The value cannot be removed while the product is not a draft. If the product type requires variant attributes, the new variants start switched off: fill in their attributes on the Variants tab, then switch them on.
products.options.mediaLinked: Images {images} are linked to a value this change removes. Unlink them on the Media tab first.
products.options.replaceConfirmBody: All {now} variants are deleted and {after} new ones are generated. Their SKUs, barcodes, attribute values, flags and prices are lost and cannot be restored.
products.optionReason.empty_value_list: Choose at least one value of this option, or stop using it.
products.optionReason.too_many_values: At most 30 values of one option.
products.optionReason.too_many_variants_: These options would make more than 250 variants. Choose fewer values.
products.optionReason.too_many_new_varia: This would generate more than 250 variants at once. Choose fewer values.
products.variants.hint.defaultNeedsActiv: Only an active variant can become the default of a published product.
products.variants.hint.default_variant_i: The default variant of a published product stays on; make another variant the default first.
products.variants.hint.no_active_variant: A published product keeps at least one active variant.
products.variants.hint.product_not_draft: Variants of a published or archived product are not deleted; switch them off instead.
products.variants.hint.default_variant: The default variant cannot be deleted; make another variant the default first.
products.variants.hint.last_variant: The last variant cannot be deleted.
products.variants.caption: Variants of the product ({count})
products.variants.columnProblems: Problems from the last publish attempt
products.variants.none: The product has no variants. Generate them from the options.
products.variants.skuHint: Letters A to Z, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen, at most {max}; unique in the whole shop. Lowercase letters are saved in upper case.
products.variants.barcodeHint: Optional, at most {max} characters; not checked for uniqueness.
products.variants.isActive: Active (sold in the shop when the product is published and the variant has a price)
products.variants.allowBackorder: Sell beyond the stock on hand
products.variants.noAttributeFields: The product type has no variant attributes.
products.variants.skuProposed: Optional: without one the shop proposes a SKU from the slug and the values.
products.variants.createAttributesLater: Fill in the variant's attributes after it is created (Edit).
products.variants.introShipping: Each variant is one purchasable unit with its own SKU. The product type ships physical goods.
products.variants.introNoShipping: Each variant is one purchasable unit with its own SKU. The product type does not ship (digital goods): new variants do not count stock unless you switch it on.
products.variants.pricesElsewhere: Prices and stock of each variant are kept on the Prices and Stock tabs.
products.variants.generatedInactive: The product type requires variant attributes: variants generated for this published product start switched off until their attributes are filled in.
products.variants.generateHint: Creates a variant for every combination of the chosen option values that has none yet; existing variants are not changed.
products.variants.deleteBody: The variant and its prices are deleted for good. Only a variant of a draft product can be deleted, never the default or the last one, and never one with stock history or orders.
products.variants.deleteHint: This variant cannot be deleted. Switch it off instead.
products.variants.combinationTaken: A variant with these values exists already.
products.notice.generated: Variants generated: {created} new, {skipped} combinations had one already.
products.notice.valueAdded: The value is added and its variants are generated.
products.prices.intro: Prices are stored in minor units of each currency, exactly as entered. The shop sells in {currency} only; prices in other currencies are kept but never sold or converted.
products.prices.inputHint: Type a price with a dot as the decimal separator and no spaces, for example 1234.50. An empty compare-at price means none; it must be higher than the price.
products.prices.removeWhileDirty: Save or discard your changes before you remove a price.
products.prices.caption: Prices of the variants ({count})
products.prices.decimals: Up to {exponent} digits after the dot
products.prices.lastShopPrice: The shop-currency price of an active variant of a published product cannot be removed. Unpublish the product or switch the variant off first.
products.prices.removeBody: The variant keeps its other prices. This cannot be undone; enter the price again to restore it.
products.prices.removeShopBody: This is the price in the shop currency. Without it the variant cannot be sold, and the product cannot be published while the variant is active.
products.prices.removeHint: The price could not be removed. Unpublish the product or switch the variant off first.
products.prices.reason.comma_separator: Use a dot as the decimal separator, for example 12.50.
products.prices.reason.inner_space: Remove the spaces inside the number, for example 1234.50.
products.prices.reason.invalid_format: Enter a number such as 12 or 12.50.
products.prices.reason.too_many_decimals: This currency has fewer digits after the dot.
products.prices.reason.amount_required: Enter a price next to the compare-at price.
products.prices.reason.stored_needs_amou: A stored price cannot be emptied. Use “Remove the price” to delete it.
products.prices.reason.compare_at_not_gr: The compare-at price must be higher than the price.
products.prices.reason.too_many_changes: At most 500 prices can be saved at once. Save part of the changes first.
products.stock.intro: Quantities per location as the server holds them. Available is on hand minus reserved; the shop shows “low stock” at {threshold} or fewer available units.
products.stock.serverDecides: A change is sent once and never repeated by itself. After every answer the levels and the journal are read again, so what you see is what the server stored.
products.stock.noLocations: No stock location exists, so stock cannot be shown or changed.
products.stock.switchWhileDirty: Send or clear the adjustment form before you open another variant.
products.stock.caption: Stock of the variants ({count})
products.stock.notTracked: This variant does not count stock: it is always available in the shop. Changes are still recorded in the journal.
products.stock.backorderNote: This variant may be sold beyond its stock (backorder): reserved units can exceed the units on hand.
products.stock.noLevels: No stock recorded yet. The first change creates the level.
products.stock.kindHint.receipt: Units that arrived: the quantity is added.
products.stock.kindHint.adjustment: A correction after a count, damage or loss: add, remove, or enter the counted quantity.
products.stock.kindHint.return: Units a customer returned: the quantity is added.
products.stock.modeLabel.delta: By how much the stock changes
products.stock.currentLevel: At this location now: {onHand} on hand, {reserved} reserved.
products.stock.changeHint: A whole number: positive adds units, negative (with a minus, for example -3) removes them.
products.stock.countedHint: The whole number of units that are there now. The server computes the change from the stock at the moment it is saved.
products.stock.referenceHint: Optional, for example a delivery note number; at most {max} characters.
products.stock.confirmLowerBody: On hand at {location} goes from {before} to {after} ({delta}), if the stock has not changed since it was read. A change below the reserved units is refused.
products.stock.confirmSetBody: On hand at {location} becomes {after} (now {before}, a change of {delta}). The server computes the change from the stock at the moment it is saved.
products.stock.result.refusedBody: Nothing was recorded. The reason is shown at the form; the levels and the journal were read again.
products.stock.result.new_by_you: The journal shows a new movement by you: the change was most likely recorded. Compare it with what you sent and do not send it again.
products.stock.result.new_by_other: The newest movement in the journal is someone else’s. Check the journal before you send the change again.
products.stock.result.none_new: The journal shows no new movement: the change was not recorded. You may send it again.
products.stock.journalHint: Every change of the units on hand, newest first. Movements cannot be edited or deleted.
products.stock.reservationsHint: Units held for orders. They are released when an order is cancelled or expires and sold when it is paid.
products.stock.noReservations.active: No units are held for orders now.
products.stock.issue.invalid_quantity: Enter a whole number, for example 5 or -3.
products.stock.issue.no_change: This does not change the stock.
products.stock.issue.kind_requires_incre: A receipt or a return must add units. Use a correction to remove units.
products.stock.issue.negative_on_hand: The stock cannot go below zero.
products.stock.issue.on_hand_out_of_rang: The stock would become too large (at most 1 000 000 000 units).
products.stock.issue.below_reserved: The stock cannot go below the reserved units. Wait until the orders are paid, cancelled or expired, then try again.
products.stock.result.unreadable: The journal could not be read again. Look at the journal below before you send the change again.
products.media.uploadLimits: Allowed: {types}; at most {max} MB per file and {files} files at a time.
products.media.uploadHint: Uploaded files are added to the list below but are not saved with the product until you save the images. If you leave without saving, the files stay on the server unused and are deleted after 24 hours.
products.media.dropHint: You can also drop image files on the list.
products.media.uploadsOff: Uploading files is switched off on this server. You can still add images by their address.
